author: Walt Disney Imagineering YouTube
text:
Villains Land, Monstropolis, Avengers Campus & More | Pardon Our Pixie Dust: D23 Edition
Welcome to a special D23 Edition of Pardon Our Pixie Dust ✨
Join Walt Disney Imagineering for a look at some of the projects currently in development across Disney Experiences. This episode features construction progress, attraction updates, and a behind-the-scenes look at work taking place on projects including Villains Land, Monstropolis, Avengers Campus, Piston Peak National Park, and Tropical Americas.

🦺 *Behind-the-Walls with Imagineers*
Pardon Our Pixie Dust goes behind the construction walls to give you an update on the magic being brought to life by Walt Disney Imagineering!

text:
Behind the Scenes of the Encanto Attraction Coming to Disney World
Step inside the recording studio for "Antonio's Fiesta de Encanto" - the first-ever "Encanto" ride coming to Walt Disney World! Get a first look at Stephanie Beatriz, Diane Guerrero, and Jessica Darrow - the voices of Mirabel, Isabela, and Luisa - recording brand new dialogue for the Tropical Americas attraction at Disney's Animal Kingdom.
